change.purpose: Operator request 2026-09-30: 'Det bör gå att prioritera ett Greenfield Chrome fönster/session så att den instansen alltid körs med förtur i kö om Max parallella Greenfield >1. Detta ska alltid låsa en av platserna exclusivt för detta fönster. Orsaken är att det finns prioriterade GFW (Greenfiled works) som behöver köras 24/7 medan de andra paralella fönstren får dela på de övriga'.
change.before: lib/global-capacity-scheduler.mjs admitted waiters by effective priority with aging (one level per 3 min) and age, non-preemptively, over one pool of Max parallella slots. Two other windows could hold both slots of Max parallella 2 and an URGENT window waited; an aged LOW waiter from another window could win a freed slot (reproduced: tests/v1812-reserved-slot.test.mjs test 1, and tests 2-7 fail on v1.8.11's scheduler: 1/7).
change.design: One reservation (operator setting reservedWorkerId = the Chrome window's verified Greenfield worker binding). Applies only when the configured Max parallella is 2 or more. With effective capacity >= 2 one slot is exclusive to the reserved worker (EXCLUSIVE): it is free for that worker whenever it has no running turn, no other worker may use it even while the reserved worker is idle, and the other workers share effective capacity - 1 with the unchanged priority/aging order. With effective capacity 1 (serial rate-limit recovery) the reserved worker is first in line but the slot is not locked (FIRST_IN_LINE); at 0 (cooldown) nobody sends (SUSPENDED). Running turns are never pre-empted: if the other workers hold all slots when the reservation is set, the reserved worker gets the next freed slot and no other waiter does.
change.implementation: lib/global-capacity-scheduler.mjs: waiters and active turns carry workerId; laneSelection computes runnable waiters per lane; every entry point takes reservedWorkerId; snapshots report reservation {workerId, mode, reservedActive, reservedSlotFree, sharedCapacity, activeShared, sharedAvailableSlots}. lib/operator-settings.mjs: reservedWorkerId. background.js: schedulerCapacityContext derives the applied reservation (configured >= 2), all 10 scheduler call sites pass it and the process's workerId, EIC_GF_SET_RESERVED_SLOT (setReservedSlot, via withVerifiedWorkerMessage; one reservation at a time; wakes runnable waiters; audit SCHEDULER_RESERVED_SLOT_UPDATED), fleetStatus.reservation. Side panel: Drift -> Reserverad plats (this window), worker-card button Reservera plats / Släpp reserverad plats and badge, capacity line '1 plats reserverad'; texts in lib/operations-view.mjs.
change.unchanged: Global prompt pacing (policy minGapSeconds, post delay) and all safety gates apply to every window; turn ownership, exact-once dispatch and the per-window mission queues are unchanged.

environment.kind: local Node harness with real background.js and mocked Chrome APIs; Chromium via Playwright for panel tools

reproductionBeforeChange.command: scheduler tests 1-7 of tests/v1812-reserved-slot.test.mjs against v1.8.11's lib
reproductionBeforeChange.result: 1/7 (test 1 characterises v1.8.11: the prioritized window waits; tests 2-7 need the reservation)

claimBoundary.multiWindow: scheduler lanes verified with several synthetic workers in unit tests; the background E2E runs one real window against seeded turns of other workers
claimBoundary.packageIntegrity: INTEGRITY.json binds packaged bytes; not a code-correctness proof

knownRemainingRisks: The reservation follows the window's Greenfield worker binding; a new Chrome window has a new binding and is not reserved
A reserved window that is closed for good keeps its slot locked until the operator removes the reservation (shown in the panel)

Prompt pacing still applies to every window: the reserved window can wait one pacing gap per other window posting at the same time (at most Max parallella - 1 gaps); derived from the code, not measured live
Scheduler entries written before 1.8.12 have no workerId until the turn ends or the next post-restart reconciliation; such a running turn of the reserved window counts as shared meanwhile
Everything listed for 1.8.11 (virtualized thread, 'Läs svar' binding scope) still applies
